## What this adds

The public website — every visitor-facing page that was previously an empty stub.

Home, services, portfolio, testimonials, contact, booking, and privacy are implemented with real layouts and forms connected to the API.

## Highlights

- React Query hooks for projects and testimonials
- Contact and booking forms with validation
- Shared `FormField` component
- Loading states and project not-found handling

## How to test

Browse all public routes, submit both forms with a local database, and confirm success feedback.

Merged into `Dev` after #13. Admin dashboard followed in #15.
